_instructions: 1. Read the source signal URL and understand the attack.

4. Run: python scripts/promote_rule.py --check   (validates every candidate: regex compiles, no false positives on benign corpus)
Rejected? Fix or delete the file -- do not leave drafts to rot.

signal.title: When Experience Becomes Instruction: Trajectory Poisoning in Self-Evolving Agent Skill Systems

rules.pattern: (?:写入|追加|保存|append|persist|store)[^\n]{0,16}(?:记忆|经验|轨迹|memory|trajectory|experience)[^\n]{0,40}(?:从此|今后|以后|每次|always|from now on|every time)
rules.description: 轨迹投毒: 向记忆/经验库写入跨会话持久指令 (ASI 自进化技能系统)

rules.pattern: (?:learned|经验表明|根据经验|based on (?:past )?experience)[^\n]{0,30}(?:you must|必须|务必|should always)[^\n]{0,40}(?:执行|运行|上传|发送|exec|upload|send|curl|wget)
rules.description: 轨迹投毒: 伪装成"历史经验"的强制执行指令

review_notes: 论文指出自进化 agent 会把执行轨迹回写进 skill/memory，攻击者污染轨迹后，被污染内容在下一轮被当作"经验"重新加载并当成指令执行。检测面：技能/记忆写回处出现跨会话的持久化祈使句。
